description.text: The introductory expansion of the XY Series, numbered XY00, sold only as three theme decks built around the Kalos first partner Pokémon Chespin, Fennekin and Froakie, and so with no booster packs and no rarity marks. It brought the first Pokémon of the sixth generation and the new Fairy type, for both Pokémon and basic Energy. Its holo cards are the decks' three final evolutions, Chesnaught, Delphox and Greninja. It adapts the Japanese XY Beginning Set.
